content.description: New durable memory content to store. Keep it concise and factual; do not store transient task progress, command output, logs, or one-off errors.

scope.description: Use project for this project only. Use global for cross-project user preferences or standing instructions.

kind.description: Short category such as preference, decision, fact, instruction, identity, constraint, or workflow.

tags.description: Optional short lowercase tags for filtering and review. Prefer preference, decision, project, identity, workflow, or constraint when applicable.

confidence.description: Confidence that this memory should be reused later. Defaults to 1.

pinned.description: Whether this memory should be preferred in fallback context. Pin only high-value long-term memory.
